title: gluta pubescens
intro: Gluta pubescens, commonly known as the Sapu-Sapu or Kaya Samarang tree, is a medicinal plant species native to Southeast Asia. This plant is renowned for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Gluta pubescens include treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as acting as an antiseptic and antipyretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
